ResearchProjectDef.label: bionic locomotive spine
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an advanced artificial locomotive spine. It is designed to replace the lower parts of the spine of a snake-like being. Unlike a regular bionic spine this one will significantly aid locomotion for such beings.

ResearchProjectDef.label: bionic strider leg
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture an advanced artificial leg. With its biogel nerve-link, powerful mini-servos, and lattice-dust healing system. This version is usually somewhat inferior to the bionic leg for baseline humans, but is slightly better for beings with more than two legs.
